svg.data-power-supply-options: NC57-1600W-ACFW (AC) and NC57-1600W-DCFW (DC), 1600 W each, two, 1+1 redundant, installed from the front
svg.data-optics-sfp28: guide Table 2 lists forty-eight 25G SFP28 ports
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: guide Table 2 lists eight 100G QSFP28 ports
svg.data-redundancy: two 1+1 power supplies and two route processors, one active and one standby; the fan trays work with N+1 redundancy (guide, Fan Modules and Fan Trays)
